{{Top|leg}}
'''Operation Ardent Wave''' was a two-part military operation carried out by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Battle of the Syvris system|evacuated]] a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] listening post in the [[Syvris system/Legends|Syvris system]], and [[Battle of the Llanic system|destroyed]] an Imperial chemical weapons station in the [[Llanic system/Legends|Llanic system]].<ref name="SW TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
